edges.claim_a: There are 25,000 times more hours of content produced annually on YouTube than on traditional television networks and streaming services combined
edges.claim_b: Chinese exporters cut prices by an average of 8 percent to find buyers in new markets
edges.explanation: In both cases, a structural abundance of supply (content volume; export goods) forces unit value compression as producers compete for scarce high-quality demand (focused attention; willing buyers), demonstrating that supply-side expansion without corresponding demand scarcity collapses per-unit value across media economics and trade economics respectively.

edges.claim_a: 27% of leaders anticipate AI-related headcount impact in 2026
edges.claim_b: For every percentage point increase in AI adoption, demand for management roles emphasizing judgment increases by 2.5% to 7.5%
edges.explanation: Both claims instantiate the same formal relationship across different empirical contexts: AI adoption displaces undifferentiated labor while simultaneously increasing proportional demand for roles requiring non-automatable judgment, generating the prediction that net headcount effects mask compositional shifts toward higher-order roles that neither article alone makes explicit.

edges.claim_a: 61% of respondents report negative tariff impacts on their costs
edges.claim_b: Chinese exporters cut prices by an average of 8 percent to find buyers in new markets
edges.explanation: Both claims assert the same causal mechanism — tariffs impose cost pressure that forces economic actors to absorb or redistribute that pressure — operating in different empirical contexts: US business leaders absorbing higher input costs domestically, and Chinese exporters compressing margins to remain competitive in displaced export markets.

edges.claim_a: Physicians typically enter the workforce in their thirties after intensive training but with limited exposure to business practices, whereas their nonclinical peers have spent years working with budgets and building strategic experience
edges.claim_b: For every percentage point increase in AI adoption, demand for management roles emphasizing judgment increases by 2.5% to 7.5%
edges.explanation: Both claims instantiate the same formal structure: accumulated experiential practice in a domain generates compounding positional advantage that credentialed knowledge alone cannot substitute, such that the gap between practitioners with lived exposure and those without widens as the value of judgment-based roles increases — a prediction neither article makes alone about how experience-as-practice diverges from knowledge-as-content under conditions of role specialization.
